author: TeIq
content:
Architect verdict: APPROVE (after one continuation + one architect-trailing migration fix).

Independent verification:
- cargo build --workspace: clean.
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean.
- cargo fmt --check: exit 0.
- cargo test -p polaris-backend --no-run --tests: 6 binaries compile (lib, main, db_smoke, oidc_login_flow, session_expiry, sql_injection_auth).
- SQLX_OFFLINE=true cargo build --workspace: clean — .sqlx/ cache (10 entries) sufficient.
- Forbidden-pattern grep clean: zero unwrap/expect in non-test src; zero string-built SQL; zero Arc<PgPool>; zero anyhow outside main.rs; zero unsafe; zero crate-root allows.
- Cookie hygiene verified in source: Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax with an explicit !SameSite=Strict test guard.
- OsRng confirmed at crypto.rs:157 (AES-GCM nonces) and session.rs:59 (session IDs).
- Live tests passed against Postgres 16 in the continuation run: 22 lib unit + 3 expiry + 1 SQL-injection + crypto tests all green.

Architect-trailing fix: prepended 'CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;' to migrations/00000000000001_auth.sql so gen_random_uuid() is portable across PG versions (continuation surfaced this; subagent had worked around by pinning new tests to PG 16-alpine). Build/clippy/fmt re-verified clean after.

Initial dispatch truncated mid-report (tool_uses hit 125); state-checks revealed partial completion (1 of 3 integration tests landed) and clippy/fmt regressions; one focused continuation closed all three gaps without scope creep.
